# Awesome Agents

> Your comprehensive guide to AI models, agents, and the future of intelligence with reviews, leaderboards, news, and tools.

Awesome Agents serves as a central hub for staying informed about AI developments, from model releases and agent frameworks to industry analysis and regulatory policy. The site aggregates reviews, leaderboards, and curated news to help users navigate the rapidly evolving AI landscape.

- AI agents
- Large language models
- Claude
- OpenAI
- Anthropic
- Model releases
- AI news
- Industry analysis
- Regulatory policy
- Market trends
- Research updates
- Licensing disputes
- Cursor
- Composer 2
- Kimi K2.5
